title.narrative: Humanitarian Assistance and Resilience Programme Facility (HARP)

description.narrative: This activity Humanitarian Assistance and Resilience Programme Facility (HARP) is a component of Burma Humanitarian Assistance and Resilience Programme reported by FCDO with a funding type of 105 - Humanitarian assistance and a budget of £89,429,132. It works in the following sector(s): Emergency food assistance, Immediate post-emergency reconstruction and rehabilitation, Material relief assistance and services, Relief co-ordination and support services.
